thread:
nate_release: Heads-up team: coordinating a cross-service push tonight at 22:30 PDT (quiet window). Targets: runtime v1.8.3 (batching opt), router header-sanitizer flag, console schema v1.6.0. API should be pinned to v2.3.1 for the canary to avoid field drift. Any immediate red flags?

olga_runtime: runtime build green. Batching kernel toggle may increase p99 under some parse-heavy flows; suggest a short load soak before traffic ramp. Will add runtime.batch.mode=experimental for canary.

maya_console: schema bump introduces device_id optional -> previously required. We added fallback but need to ensure analytics doesn't assume presence. Adding a fallback mapper should cover it.

trent_router: I'll gate header-sanitizer behind a flag router-sanitize-1729 on canary routers only. Canary scope ok. Do we want synthetic header tests in the pipeline?

zoe_qe: I'll run header + analytics e2e matrix against staging with API pinned. Plan: synthetic traffic with missing device_id and with long header values. Results in ~12m.

nate_release: Canary plan: 10% for 10m -> 40% for 20m -> 100% if green. Rollback triggers: error rate >0.7% OR p95 latency degradation >25ms for 10m. Also immediate rollback if ingestion 5xxs > baseline*3.

deploybot: @channel Deploybot scheduled canary in 8m. Manifest snapshot: runtime:v1.8.3-batch-exp, router:flag=router-sanitize-1729(canary), console:v1.6.0-schema, api:v2.3.1-pinned. Preflight checks: unit tests, integration smoke, schema-compat. Logs -> #release-logs.

olga_runtime: enabling runtime.batch.mode=experimental on canary nodes and emitting metrics runtime.batch.latency and runtime.kernel.queue_depth. Will also pre-warm sequence cache.

maya_console: adding 'schema-deviceid-smoke' to preflight. It asserts analytics mapper falls back to anonymous device and doesn't throw.

zoe_qe: started matrix runs. First pass failing on analytics mapping for missing device_id: stack trace shows mapper NPE at AnalyticsMapper.java:42. Payload example: {"user":"abc","device":null}.

nate_release: Pause traffic shift and hold canary. Do not advance to 40%. We need an emergency patch to handle null device values. Also remove router header-sanitizer from canary until mapper is fixed.

deploybot: Pausing traffic progression. Rolling back router flag on canary clusters and reverting console to previous schema (v1.5.5) in canary. Will post status when done.

olga_runtime: Observing canary metrics. No p95 regressions so far, but ingestion 5xxs ticked up slightly during initial push.

maya_console: working on hotfix branch: add null-safe device mapper + extra unit tests. Will push v1.6.0-1 after CI.

zoe_qe: rerunning the smoke suite against the hotfix branch in staging once it's available. ETA ~12m.

nate_release: New checklist items: 1) require API pin in console deploy specs, 2) include schema-deviceid-smoke in deploybot preflight, 3) add synthetic header tests to router pipeline, 4) runtime soak before traffic ramp. I'll open follow-ups and tag owners.

deploybot: Router flag rollback complete in canary; console revert complete. Traffic frozen at 10% canary. Notifying @release-team. :white_check_mark:
